english.title: Use equipment for transmission / recording / amplification etc. of sound / images for commercial use at Bristol Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without the written permission of Bristol Airport Limited, or without lawful authority or reasonable cause or excuse, used equipment for the transmission, receipt, recording, reproduction or amplification of sound, speech or images for commercial purposes at Bristol Airport
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5.12 and 3.4 of the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.

english.notes: This Byelaw describes an act which is prohibited unless the written permission of Bristol Airport Limited has first been obtained or unless the act is performed by a person acting with lawful authority or reasonable cause or excuse in circumstances in which the obtaining of permission would be likely to hinder that person so acting.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, without the written permission of Bristol Airport Limited, or without lawful authority or reasonable cause or excuse, used equipment for the transmission, receipt, recording, reproduction or amplification of sound, speech or images for commercial purposes at Bristol Airport.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
6 months
